name: Tessera Logistics Van
description: A mid-size autonomous delivery van that handles last-mile logistics in Tier 2-4 districts. White, featureless, ubiquitous. There are so many T-Vans on the road that they've become effectively invisible — the perfect anonymous vehicle. Criminal organizations have taken notice. An unmarked white van identical to ten thousand others is the best disguise in GLMZ.
autonomy: Fully autonomous with remote human oversight
armament: None. Cargo bay locks and tracking.
common_usage: Package delivery, supply restocking, medical transport, and a disturbingly high percentage of criminal operations.
story_hooks: A Tessera Van has been making deliveries to an address that doesn't exist — same time every week for three years
Someone is using decommissioned T-Vans as mobile data centers, parking them in different locations each night
physical_description: A boxy white delivery van, roughly 4.5 meters long, with a seamless composite hull that's already showing micro-cracks and rain-stain discoloration. Sliding side doors, reinforced cargo bay, and a stubby autonomous sensor array mounted on the roof—all designed for anonymous, tireless work. The paint is matte and industrial, deliberately unmarked except for faded Tessera Transit decals that could belong to any of the thousands clogging GLMZ streets.
